solutions.check: bars rebuilt from the blog's numbered answers (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Genus of fruit breeds needing pruning at the start

indicators.note: pruning cuts something back, and at the start says the cut comes off the front of the word

parts.note: tribes are races or breeds of people or animals

explanation.surface: A horticulturist says a fruit genus has breeds that need cutting back early.
explanation.walkthrough: TRIBES loses its first letter T to leave RIBES.
explanation.definitionFit: Ribes is the botanical genus containing currants and gooseberries, the berry-bearing shrubs.

clue.text: Had rub working with small piece of sponge

indicators.note: something working is in motion, so these letters are set moving into a new order

parts.note: taken as written
S is the standard abbreviation for small

explanation.surface: Someone scrubbed away with a small bit of sponge.
explanation.definitionFit: A rhabdus is a rod-shaped spicule, one of the tiny skeletal pieces that make up a sponge.

clue.text: Guarantee banning nuclear ship by law

indicators.note: banning something keeps it out, so the named letters are excluded from the word

parts.note: to insure is to guarantee against loss
NS is the abbreviation for nuclear ship

explanation.surface: A legal guarantee prohibits nuclear-powered vessels.
explanation.walkthrough: INSURE without its N and S leaves IURE.
explanation.definitionFit: Iure is the Latin ablative meaning according to right or legally, as in de iure.

clue.text: Parasite left in aviary, hard to get eradicated

indicators.note: in places one letter inside the longer word
eradicated means wiped out, so that letter is removed entirely

parts.note: an aviary is a house for birds
H stands for hard, as on pencils
L is the abbreviation for left

explanation.surface: Something parasitic was left in an aviary and proved hard to get rid of.
explanation.walkthrough: L goes into BIRDHOUSE and the H drops out, a swap of one letter for another.
explanation.definitionFit: A bird louse is a small wingless insect that lives on and feeds from birds' feathers and skin.

clue.text: Fish dish that's good for canine

indicators.note: one thing standing for another means it takes the other's place

parts.note: a saucer is a small dish
G is the abbreviation for good
C denotes a canine tooth in dental notation

explanation.surface: A fish dish described as suitable for feeding a dog.
explanation.walkthrough: In SAUCER the C gives way to G. C for canine comes from dental formulae, where incisors, canines and molars are written I, C, M.
explanation.definitionFit: The sauger is a North American freshwater perch related to the walleye.

clue.text: Rumour about English dress material

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so one word wraps around the other

parts.note: a kite is a rumour or suggestion put out to test opinion, as in flying a kite
ENG is the abbreviation for English

explanation.surface: Gossip is spreading about an English fabric for frocks.
explanation.definitionFit: A kitenge is a brightly printed East African cotton cloth used for wraps and garments.

clue.text: Primate acceptable in wild pink, I judge?

indicators.note: in puts one letter inside the rearranged group
wild suggests disorder, so these letters are thrown into a new arrangement

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written
J is the abbreviation for judge
U means acceptable, upper-class usage

explanation.surface: Someone asks whether a primate would be acceptable in pink.
explanation.walkthrough: The question mark marks the definition as a guess at an example rather than a plain synonym.
explanation.definitionFit: The kipunji is a monkey discovered in Tanzania in 2003, a species of primate.

clue.text: Legal land decision gets reversed

indicators.note: the word gets turned round so its letters run the other way

parts.note: an arret is a judgment or decision of a court, from French

explanation.surface: A court decision about land is overturned on appeal.
explanation.definitionFit: Terra is the Latin word for land, used in legal phrases such as terra firma and terra nullius.

clue.text: Vain relative spitting blood

parts.note: vain words are empty ones
sis is short for sister

explanation.surface: A conceited relative is coughing up blood.
explanation.definitionFit: Emptysis is the medical term for haemoptysis, bringing up blood from the lungs.

clue.text: What's been used to purify government advanced moral filth

parts.note: G is the abbreviation for government
A is the abbreviation for advanced, as in A level
slime is figuratively anything morally disgusting

explanation.surface: A puritan campaign: something used to cleanse government of advancing moral corruption.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition reads as a political clean-up; in fact it is a chemical one in old gasworks.
explanation.definitionFit: Gas lime is slaked lime once used to purify coal gas, and the spent residue left afterwards.

clue.text: Polish European reform

parts.note: E is the abbreviation for European
to mend is to reform or put right

explanation.surface: Political talk of reform across Poland and Europe.
explanation.walkthrough: Polish at the start hides its lower-case sense: it is the verb, not the nationality.
explanation.definitionFit: To emend a text is to correct and improve it, polishing away its faults.

clue.text: Verse I found in shed, one in Anglo-Norman

indicators.note: found in says one letter sits inside the following word
in again places the letter inside an abbreviation

parts.note: a hut is a shed
the Roman numeral for one
AN is the abbreviation for Anglo-Norman
taken as written

explanation.surface: A poet discovers a verse in a garden shed, one written in Anglo-Norman.
explanation.definitionFit: A huitain is a stanza or poem of eight lines, from the French for eight.

clue.text: Royal form of address accepted in Mayan language

indicators.note: in places the abbreviation inside the language's name

parts.note: Mam is a Mayan language of Guatemala
A is the abbreviation for accepted, as on bills of exchange

explanation.surface: A courtly title has been adopted into a Mayan tongue.
explanation.definitionFit: Ma'am is how the Queen or a royal princess is addressed after the first greeting.

clue.text: Guess late queen's entered place above?

indicators.note: has entered means one piece has gone inside the other

parts.note: to suppose is to guess
ER, Elizabeth Regina, the late Queen Elizabeth

explanation.surface: Someone guesses the late Queen has taken her place on high.
explanation.walkthrough: The question mark flags that place above is a verb phrase, not a heavenly location.
explanation.definitionFit: To superpose is to lay one thing on top of another so they coincide.

clue.text: What grows on rose patch alongside eastern legume

indicators.note: alongside puts the pieces next to each other in a row

parts.note: a bed is a garden patch
E is the abbreviation for eastern
guar is a bean plant grown for fodder and gum

explanation.surface: A gardener lists what grows in the rose patch next to an Asian bean.
explanation.definitionFit: A bedeguar is a mossy gall formed on wild roses by a gall wasp, a growth on the plant.

clue.text: Tawny-toed wild bird

indicators.note: wild suggests disorder, so the letters run riot into a new order

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: A wild bird with tawny feet.
explanation.definitionFit: The Wyandotte is an American breed of domestic chicken, a farmyard fowl.

clue.text: Red alga expected to absorb lake sulphur

indicators.note: absorbing takes something inside, so one word holds the others

parts.note: due means expected, as a train is due
L is the abbreviation for lake
S is the chemical symbol for sulphur

explanation.surface: A seaweed is expected to take up sulphur from a lake.
explanation.definitionFit: Dulse is an edible red seaweed gathered on Atlantic shores.

clue.text: Aggressive salesman, one rejecting news item about fraud regularly

indicators.note: about means going around, so the outer word wraps the kept letters

parts.note: an editor spikes a story when rejecting it, so one who does is a spiker

indicators.note: regularly means at even intervals, so every other letter is kept

parts.note: second and fourth letters

explanation.surface: A pushy salesman, rejecting a news report, is accused of fraud now and then.
explanation.walkthrough: Spruiker is Australian slang, so many solvers meet it only through this sort of clue.
explanation.definitionFit: In Australia a spruiker is a showman or tout who harangues passers-by to drum up custom.

clue.text: Honorary title, eg one daughter used about Yemen's leader

indicators.note: about means placed around, so the pieces enclose that letter

parts.note: say is used like eg to introduce an example

indicators.note: a leader is the one in front, so only the opening letter is wanted

parts.note: the opening letter
the Roman numeral for one
D is the abbreviation for daughter

explanation.surface: A father explains how an honorific was used for one daughter by Yemen's ruler.
explanation.walkthrough: SAY, I and D together go around the Y of Yemen.
explanation.definitionFit: Sayyid is a Muslim honorific given to men accepted as descendants of the Prophet Muhammad.

clue.text: Assault succeeded on a boy in church

indicators.note: in a down entry, on means sitting above, so this letter comes first

parts.note: S is the abbreviation for succeeded

indicators.note: in places the words inside the abbreviation for the church

parts.note: CE is the Church of England
taken as written
a lad is a boy

explanation.surface: A violent attack on a boy in church has been successful.
explanation.definitionFit: A scalade, like escalade, is an attack on a fortification by climbing the walls with ladders.

clue.text: Dandy old leg strap girl's chasing

indicators.note: chasing means running behind, so this piece follows the other

parts.note: a jess is the short strap fastened round a hawk's leg in falconry
Amy is a girl's name

explanation.surface: A girl is running after a fop's old leg strap.
explanation.definitionFit: Jessamy is an archaic word for a fop or effeminate dandy, from the scented jasmine flower.

clue.text: Escape throwing ninety out of bar

indicators.note: throwing something out gets rid of it, so those letters go
out of completes the phrase, telling us the letters leave the following word

parts.note: to bar someone is exclusion
XC is ninety in Roman numerals

explanation.surface: A rowdy drinker of ninety is ejected from the pub and escapes.
explanation.walkthrough: Bar is the noun meaning prohibition here, not a pub; EXCLUSION loses its XC.
explanation.definitionFit: Elusion is the act of evading or slipping away, an archaic synonym for escape.

clue.text: Cassava and cane region of Mexico

indicators.note: and simply adds the second piece after the first

parts.note: yuca is another name for cassava
to cane and to tan both mean to beat

explanation.surface: Cassava and sugar cane are crops grown in a Mexican region.
explanation.walkthrough: Cane looks like the sugar crop beside cassava; it is the verb meaning to thrash.
explanation.definitionFit: Yucatán is the peninsula and state in south-eastern Mexico, home of Mayan ruins.

clue.text: Awfully amusing small dog runs in lake

parts.note: S is the abbreviation for small
a cur is a mongrel dog
R is the abbreviation for runs in cricket scoring
I is a dictionary abbreviation for in
L is the abbreviation for lake

explanation.surface: A tiny dog dashing about in a lake is hugely entertaining.
explanation.definitionFit: Scurril is an old word meaning scurrilous, coarsely jocular, funny in a low and offensive way.

clue.text: Chinese leader concealing deposited capital

indicators.note: concealing means hiding inside, so one word holds the other

parts.note: Mao Zedong, the Chinese leader
put means set down or deposited

explanation.surface: A Chinese leader hides money that was deposited as capital.
explanation.walkthrough: Capital looks financial beside deposited; it is a capital city.
explanation.definitionFit: Maputo is the capital city of Mozambique, on Delagoa Bay.

clue.text: Relaxed, like university in California

indicators.note: in places the pieces inside the abbreviation for the state

parts.note: CAL is an abbreviation for California
as means like
U is the abbreviation for university

explanation.surface: Someone is laid-back, like a student at a Californian university.
explanation.definitionFit: Casual means informal and easy-going, not stiff, so relaxed in manner.

clue.text: Made with an arch man finally demolished

parts.note: cove is old slang for a man or chap

indicators.note: finally points to the very end, so only the closing letter is kept

parts.note: the last letter

explanation.surface: A man finally knocks down an archway.
explanation.definitionFit: A coved ceiling or recess is built with a concave arched curve where wall meets ceiling.

clue.text: Sacred settings that Lovelace has penned

indicators.note: to pen is to enclose, so one piece holds the other

parts.note: Ada Lovelace, the mathematician
yt is an old written abbreviation for that

explanation.surface: Settings for holy rites that Lovelace has written about.
explanation.walkthrough: Lovelace gives her first name, Ada; the y in yt was once the old letter thorn.
explanation.definitionFit: Adyta, plural of adytum, are the innermost sanctuaries of ancient temples, the holiest places.

clue.text: Naval detection system — captain having it returned

indicators.note: returned means sent back, so the combination is read the other way

parts.note: a cid is a chief or captain, as in El Cid
it, as in sex appeal, is SA

explanation.surface: A naval captain gets his sonar equipment sent back.
explanation.definitionFit: Asdic was the early British name for sonar, the underwater echo equipment for finding submarines.

clue.text: What can limit inspiration running open days

indicators.note: running suggests things in motion, so the letters change places

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: Running open days can stifle creative ideas.
explanation.walkthrough: Inspiration means breathing in, not creative flair.
explanation.definitionFit: Dyspnoea is laboured or difficult breathing, which restricts how much air a person can take in.

clue.text: Lamb was sickly being brought up, losing tail

indicators.note: in a down entry, brought up means read from bottom to top
losing its tail means the final letter is cut off

parts.note: ailed means was unwell

explanation.surface: A lamb was sickly as it was raised, and lost its tail.
explanation.definitionFit: Elia was the pen name of the essayist Charles Lamb, author of the Essays of Elia.

clue.text: See drunk one among game river goddesses

parts.note: V for vide, Latin for see
alky is slang for an alcoholic

indicators.note: among puts one letter in the middle of another group

parts.note: RU is rugby union
the Roman numeral for one
R is the abbreviation for river

explanation.surface: Look: a drunk joins river goddesses at a game.
explanation.definitionFit: Valkyriur is the Old Norse plural of Valkyrie, the war maidens who chose the slain for Valhalla.

clue.text: Golf club pulling out with advantage

indicators.note: pulling something out removes it, so that letter goes

parts.note: a wedge is a lofted golf club
W is the abbreviation for with

explanation.surface: A golf club withdrawing from a tournament gives a rival the upper hand.
explanation.definitionFit: Having the edge over someone means holding a slight lead or superiority.

clue.text: Catalogue old monkey in North America

indicators.note: in places the pieces inside the abbreviation for the continent

parts.note: NA is the abbreviation for North America
O is the abbreviation for old
a titi is a small South American monkey

explanation.surface: A list of an elderly monkey living in North America.
explanation.definitionFit: A notitia is a register or roll, especially a list of ecclesiastical sees or offices.

clue.text: When travelling I daren't step down onto the platform

indicators.note: travelling means moving around, so the letters shift places

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: A nervous traveller dare not step down onto the platform.
explanation.definitionFit: To detrain is to get off a railway carriage at the station.

clue.text: Vast quantity of processed cane

parts.note: O is a short form of of, as in o'clock

indicators.note: processed means worked on and changed, so the letters are remade

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: A huge amount of refined sugar cane.
explanation.definitionFit: Oceans of something, in informal usage, means an enormous amount of it.
